label: Configuration and record API views
instruction: Generate a compact DRF API view file at modules/complaint_cms/api/configuration.py (max 90 lines) providing ConfigurationView (GET returns categories and routing_rules using ComplaintCategorySerializer and RoutingRuleSerializer; POST creates or updates a ComplaintCategory or RoutingRule) and RecordListView (GET returns recent ComplaintUpdate and ComplaintNotification records serialized with ComplaintUpdateSerializer and ComplaintNotificationSerializer). Use IsAuthenticated, HasModuleGrant("complaint_cms"), and HasPermission("complaint_cms.configuration.manage") / HasPermission("complaint_cms.record.manage") in permission_classes, and @extend_schema on view methods. Return raw Python source only without code fences.
